title: Return Inspection Filing Tool for PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Return Inspection Filing Tool — PAP Therapy Equipment

## Capability

`record_return_inspection_bc7317cd` records the branch return inspection of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment device that has come back to Summit Ridge for a refund. One call files one inspection job on the device record, carrying three figures: the reconditioning labor booked for the unit, the reconditioning parts it consumed, and the amount of used accessories the patient bears. The unit is assessed and reconditioned for stock, not repaired for the patient, so the job carries no repair cost assignment. On success the inspection appears in the device's service history dated today.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_return_inspection_bc7317cd` and then calls it with the parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pap_holding_id` | the PAP device record number of the returned self-pay device, as shown by the PAP device record lookup for the patient | record number as shown |
| `serial_number` | the manufacturer serial number of the returned unit | copied character for character from the serial number shown on that PAP device record |
| `labor_units` | reconditioning labor booked on the job, counted in 15-minute labor units | non-negative whole number, no fraction |
| `parts_amount` | reconditioning parts consumed by the unit | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `repair_patient_share` | value of the used accessories the patient bears on the return | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

## Return

On success the tool returns, as text, a dictionary with:

- `status` — "recorded" when the inspection job was filed;
- `pap_service_id` — reference number of the new inspection job;
- `pap_holding_id` — the device record inspected;
- `service_date` — the inspection date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `labor_units` — the whole units booked;
- `parts_amount` and `repair_patient_share` — USD with 2 decimal places.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `labor_units` 5, `parts_amount` 31.50 and `repair_patient_share` 104.00 on a returned unit's record returns status "recorded", a new reference number, the record number, today's date and the same three figures. In the device's service history the job then shows as an inspection with no repair cost assignment.

## Contract questions

**Does one call cover several units?** No. One call files one inspection job on one device record.

**Does the job assign a repair cost?** No. The unit is assessed and reconditioned for stock, not repaired for the patient, so the job carries no repair cost assignment.
